methods.life: CecilSpawn to CecilDeath or last logged window tick; generation and local slot; all lives retained
methods.acquisition: first observed owned & 0x3df8 != 0; inventory evidence, not measured ammo readiness
methods.censoring: no acquisition before observation ends; age is lower bound
methods.starts: same physical role/local slot; spawn log XYZ and first native positive HP plus positive spawn clock; initial owned from first CecilState
methods.damage: same server entity pointer and same positive spawned_tick, positive prior HP; sum observed decreases with negative HP clipped to zero; non-atomic sparse snapshots, no armor or attacker attribution, not complete damage accounting
methods.frags: last valid query minus first valid query by fixed private roster; query window shorter than full runtime
methods.kill_messages: original server text; no timestamps inferred; aggregate only
methods.flight: exact source/hop/deadline equality on begin/end; following sampled no-reacquire checks are not continuous trajectory proof
